items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: every time I'd go to Billy for a raise, I would get it!

ctx.x: Yeah. He sang the shit out of the Blues. He ain't no Blues singer. I'd say, "Man, you ain't, huh?" Billy was something else.
We did talk about the Eckstine band earlier on. But are there any other memories of that band that come to mind?
